source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 14.11 with Figs 14.20-14.23 (PDF 38-41).

blocks.text: Hum ne dekha ke resonance par oscillator ka amplitude bohat bara ho jata hai. Amplitude aur resonance ki sharpness (tezi, yani peak kitna patla aur nokila hai) dono damping par munhasir hain. Damping jitni kam, amplitude utna zyada aur resonance utni sharp (nokili).
Heavy damping wale system ka resonance curve kaafi chapta (flat) hota hai, jaisa amplitude aur frequency ke graph Fig. 14.20 mein dikhaya gaya hai.

blocks.alt: Driving frequency ke muqable amplitude; axis par resonant frequency likhi hai. Teen curves wahan oonche hote hain: light damping ka ooncha, nokeela (sharp) peak, moderate damping ka neecha peak aur heavy damping ka taqreeban chapta curve.
blocks.caption: Figure 14.20: Damping nizam ki misal (kitab ki Figure 14.20 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Teenon curves ka peak resonant frequency par hai. Light damping ka peak sab se ooncha aur patla (sharp) hai, moderate damping ka neecha aur chaura, aur heavy damping ka curve taqreeban chapta hai.

Damping ka asar yun dekh sakte hain: ek rod se do barabar lambai ke pendulum latkayein, ek ka bob halki pith ball ho aur doosre ka usi size ka bhari lead (seese) ka bob (Fig. 14.17 jaisa set-up). Usi rod par barabar lambai ka teesra pendulum dono ko jhulata hai. Lead bob ka amplitude pith ball se kaheen zyada hota hai, kyun ke hawa ki mazahmat halki pith ball par lead bob se kaheen zyada damping karti hai.

blocks.title: Point to ponder!
blocks.text: Pulon aur doosre civil engineering mansoobon (projects) ke design mein resonance bohat ahem hai. July 1940 mein naya Tacoma Narrows pul (Washington, USA) traffic ke liye khola gaya. Sirf chaar mahine baad halki hawa ne use resonant vibrations mein daal diya; chand ghanton mein amplitude itna barh gaya ke pul dabao (stress) bardasht na kar saka aur us ka ek hissa toot kar neeche pani mein gir gaya. (Aaj engineers is ki wajah aeroelastic flutter batate hain: hawa se khud barhne wala jhoolna, jo resonance se gehra talluq rakhta hai.)
Resonance aur standing waves ke istemal
Bohat se aalaat (devices) standing waves (khari lehrein, jin ke nodes aur antinodes apni jagah tike rehte hain) banate aur istemal karte hain, aur un mein resonance kaam karti hai.
Standing waves aur resonance ka talluq kuch tajurbon se samjha ja sakta hai, jaise Rubens tube, Chladni plates aur acoustic levitation.

Rubens tube ek lamba dhaat (metal) ka pipe hai jis ke oopar ek qatar mein soorakh (holes) hote hain aur dono sire band hote hain. Ek sire par chhota speaker ya frequency generator laga hota hai aur doosra sira jalne wali gas ki supply se jura hota hai (Fig. 14.21). Pipe gas se bhar jata hai, gas soorakhon se nikalti hai aur jalaane par shoale (flames) bante hain.

blocks.alt: Gas ka cylinder aik lambe dhaat ke pipe ko gas deta hai jis ke oopar soorakh hain. Doosra sira membrane se band hai aur us ke paar loudspeaker hai. Pipe ke andar standing wave bani hai, aur oopar shoale antinodes par oonche aur nodes par neeche hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 14.21: Rubens tube ka aala (kitab ki Figure 14.21 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Shoale wahan oonche hain jahan tube ke andar pressure sab se zyada badalta hai, yani pressure antinodes par, aur nodes par neeche. Do oonche shoalon ka faasla aadhi wavelength hai. Kitab ki figure mein oonche shoale sirf lehar ki choti (crest) ke oopar hain, jab ke choti aur gehrai (trough) dono antinodes hain; khaake mein dono jagah oonche shoale hain.

blocks.title: Dilchasp maloomat
blocks.text: Rubens tube ko standing wave flame tube ya sirf flame tube bhi kehte hain. Yeh tube mein awaz ki standing waves dikhane wala aala hai, jo German physicist Heinrich Rubens ne 1905 mein banaya (kitab mein naam 'Henrich' chhapa hai).

Jab frequency generator resonance frequency ki awaz paida karta hai to tube ke andar standing wave ban jati hai. Is se tube mein kuch jagah pressure zyada aur kuch jagah kam hota hai. Jahan pressure kam hai wahan soorakhon se kam gas nikalti hai aur shoala neecha hota hai; jahan pressure zyada hai wahan zyada gas nikalti hai aur shoala ooncha hota hai.
Yeh neeche aur oonche shoale tube ke andar standing wave ke nodes aur antinodes dikha dete hain (Fig. 14.21).
Chladni plate

Chladni plate resonance ki achhi misal hai aur standing waves ka naqsha (pattern) dikhati hai. Yeh aam taur par gol ya chaukor dhaat ki plate hoti hai jo horizontal rakh kar ek vibrator par lagi hoti hai aur beech (centre) se upar neeche (transversally) hilayi jati hai (Fig. 14.22). Jab plate ko kisi resonant normal mode ki frequency par hilaya jaye to us ki satah par nodes aur antinodes ban jate hain.

blocks.title: Dhyan dein
blocks.text: Kitab yahan 'as shown in Fig. (14.20)' likhti hai, lekin Chladni plate Fig. 14.22 mein hai; Fig. 14.20 damping ka graph hai.

blocks.alt: (a) Purani (classical) Chladni plate: markazi sahare (central support) par chaukor plate, aik kinare se pakri aur doosre kinare par violin bow se bajayi jati, oopar sand shaker se ret girti; ret nodal lakeeron ke jaal par jama hai. (b) Jadeed (modern) Chladni plate: plate mechanical oscillator par, jise electrical signal input milta hai; shaker ki ret chhalle (rings) banati hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 14.22: Chladni plates, (a) classical aur (b) modern (kitab ki Figure 14.22 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Jahan nodes bante hain wahan plate nahi hilti, baqi plate apne poore amplitude se hilti hai. Yeh naqsha dekhne ke liye plate par ret (sand) ki patli tah barabar chhirak di jati hai. Ret hilne wali jagahon (antinodes) se hat kar nodes par jama ho jati hai, kyun ke nodes saakin (stationary) hain.

blocks.title: Dilchasp maloomat
blocks.text: Chladni plates physicist, musician aur saaz banane wale Ernst Chladni (1756-1827) ne 18vi sadi ke aakhir mein ijad (invent) kin; inhen standing waves ke pecheeda naqshe dikhane ke liye istemal kiya jata hai. (Kitab mein 'invented' ki jagah 'inverted' chhapa hai.)
Acoustic levitation

Acoustic levitation ek tareeqa hai jis mein taqatwar awaz ki lehron ke radiation pressure se cheezon ko gravity ke khilaf hawa mein latka (suspend) diya jata hai. Is se resonance aur standing waves ka talluq samajh aata hai. Is mein bohat unchi frequency ki awaz (ultrasonic) se styrofoam ke chhote tukre ya pani ki boondein baghair chhooe hawa mein tik jati hain.

Kaam ka tareeqa (working): acoustic levitator mein awaz ka source (transducer) aur ek reflector hota hai. Transducer ki unchi frequency wali awaz reflector se takra kar wapas aati hai. Jaati aur wapas aati lehrein mil kar standing wave banati hain: node par awaz ka pressure sab se kam aur antinode par sab se zyada hota hai. Pressure ka yeh farq chhote styrofoam zarron par gravity ke khilaf force lagata hai, aur zarre nodes par phans jate hain (Fig. 14.23). Yahan standing wave ke nodes 'acoustic traps' (awaz ke phande) ka kaam karte hain.

blocks.alt: Acoustic levitator: base par concave horn wala ultrasonic transducer, controller se jura, aur oopar stand par reflector. In ke darmiyan aik boond (droplet) hawa mein thami hai. Bara karke dikhaye hisse mein reflector aur horn ke darmiyan standing wave, node par thami boond aur aik wavelength lambda dikhayi gayi hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 14.23: Acoustic levitation ka set-up (kitab ki Figure 14.23 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Sargarmi (Activity)
blocks.text: Ustad class mein resonance tube ya Chladni plates se resonance aur standing waves ka talluq dikha sakte hain.

blocks.prompt: Do barabar lambai ke pendulum, ek pith-ball bob wala aur ek usi size ke lead bob wala, un ki natural frequency par jhulaye jate hain. Kis ka amplitude zyada hoga, aur kyun?
blocks.explanation: Lead bob ka. Hawa ki mazahmat halki pith ball ko kaheen zyada damp karti hai (us ki energy jaldi zaya hoti hai); kam damping wale lead bob ka resonance amplitude zyada aur resonance zyada sharp hoti hai.

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: Kam damping: zyada amplitude aur sharp resonance; heavy damping: chapta curve.
Tacoma Narrows (1940): hawa se resonant jhoolne ke baad pul toot gaya.
Standing waves ke saath resonance: Rubens tube (shoale), Chladni plate (ret ke naqshe), acoustic levitation (nodes par phanse zarre).
